summary: Backend smoke test for BB FM Kigali config changes (RADIO_STREAM_URL_HTTPS + Apple revocation env). 12/12 tests passed. streamUrlHttps=https://stream.bbkigali.com/stream/1/ correctly appears in /api/radio/now-playing (both from env default and after admin PUT round-trip). apple_revocation_ready() returns True and _make_apple_client_secret() produces a valid ES256 JWT (alg=ES256, kid=6HU52UN74X, iss=34P5MTCXZY, aud=https://appleid.apple.com, sub=com.emergent.radiovodplatform.reybr3). Admin OTP dev-bypass login works with phone 250794230137 code 123456. Admin PUT /api/admin/settings set→clear→restore of radioStreamUrlHttps all reflect correctly in /api/radio/now-playing. Regression: /api/live/status hides watchUrl/embedUrl/videoId for unauthenticated users; /api/radio/schedule and /api/shows (public VOD list) both return 200.

minor.issue: Endpoint mentioned in review request does not exist (404). Actual public VOD list endpoint is /api/shows. Non-blocking — treat as a typo in the review request. Test file documents both.

action_items: No fixes required for this iteration — all requested checks pass.

Optional: expose a lightweight GET /api/auth/apple/revocation-status endpoint that returns {"ready": apple_revocation_ready()} so ops can verify Apple key wiring without shelling into the pod (review request suggested it but told us not to create it; noting for future).
Optional: consider aliasing GET /api/vod/videos → GET /api/shows or updating docs so future testers/scripts don't hit the 404.
critical_code_review_comments: apple_auth.py: _make_apple_client_secret uses os.environ[...] (KeyError) instead of os.environ.get inside a helper gated by apple_revocation_ready(). Fine at runtime (server loads .env via load_dotenv before importing apple_auth), but a bare `python -c 'from apple_auth import _make_apple_client_secret; ...'` from a shell without .env loaded will crash. Not a bug — just a note for reviewers running the one-liner from the review request; they must load dotenv first.
server.py admin_put_settings correctly treats radioStreamUrlHttps='' as an explicit clear (writes null into radio_state) while None (field absent) leaves the value untouched — verified end-to-end.
server.py is 4070 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (radio, admin, billing, auth) in a future refactor. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Admin OTP login uses existing dev bypass (250794230137 / 123456).
